title: Tyler Road
description: **The site.** From "Start" (elevation 2,963 feet) to "End" (elevation 4,708 feet). The straight line between them climbs 1,746 feet in 26,459 feet (6.6%).
**Design criteria.** Maximum grade 12%, minimum curve radius 50 feet, maximum retaining wall height 20 feet, maximum cut or fill slope height 60 feet.
**Features added to the site.** They aren't the USGS's - verify them in the field:

- Streams: Draw 515, Draw 476, Draw 166, Draw 163, Draw 23, Draw 537, Draw 384, Draw 183, Draw 34, Draw 161, Draw 79, Draw 421, Draw 43, Draw 188, Draw 380, Draw 498, Draw 81, Draw 73, Draw 72, Draw 395, Draw 410, Draw 74, Draw 430, Draw 37, Draw 505, Draw 328, Draw 523, Draw 415, Draw 154, Draw 217, Draw 76, Draw 47
- The draws are the terrain's unmapped draws that the options crossed - each crossing has a culvert.

**Options.** Another corridor, "South Corridor" (through 19528,1622), was engineered and not kept - it isn't a road: no road that doesn't overlap itself - it turns back over itself at station 19436 (try other via points).

**Limitations.** The terrain is the USGS 3D Elevation Program's lidar ground elevations, and the streams, roads, and trails are the USGS National Map's. What they lack - buildings, property lines, utilities, and unmapped roads and drainages - isn't in the plan unless it was added. Turnarounds aren't modeled. The cost scores compare the options - they aren't bid estimates.

options.name: New Road
description: The least-cost option - its cost score is 9,438.7. It's 31,969 feet long and 30 feet wide, asphalt, and its maximum grade is 11%.
- **Line.** From the start, it runs east for about 4,000 feet, northeast for about 7,990 feet, east for about 14,650 feet, and northeast for about 5,330 feet to the end.

- **Structures.** 32 culverts (Cottonwood Creek culvert, station 2+37, 3 ft; Cottonwood Creek culvert, station 8+37, 3 ft; Sag cross drain, station 16+80, 1.5 ft; Draw 515 culvert, station 20+07, 3 ft; Sag cross drain, station 23+00, 1.5 ft; stream culvert, station 29+32, 3 ft; ...), 15 retaining walls (stations 62+89 to 64+19; stations 64+19 to 64+49; stations 68+29 to 73+39; stations 74+99 to 75+49; stations 83+39 to 84+39; stations 85+09 to 85+49; ...).
- **Earthwork.** 121,012 cy of cut and 46,474 cy of fill, with 58,807 cy of waste (export). Its deepest cut is 16.6 feet (station 310+90). Its deepest fill is 7.8 feet (station 302+75).
- **Cost.** Its largest items: surfacing (asphalt) 3,564.1, retaining walls 1,283.2, overhaul 1,173.4.

- **Design warnings.** The cut slope does not daylight (retaining wall needed) from 86+16 to 86+16. The retaining wall exceeds the maximum wall height from 71+93 to 71+93. The retaining wall exceeds the maximum wall height from 72+73 to 72+73. The retaining wall exceeds the maximum wall height from 96+71 to 96+87.
